2609.40165.title: PrefPI: Preference-Guided Steering into Out-of-Distribution Behaviors
2609.40165.paper_summary: We present PrefPI (Preference-Guided Policy Iteration), an iterative framework for steering pretrained generative robot policies using only relative preferences over self-generated trajectories. Unlike prior preference-learning methods that primarily sharpen modes already represented by the policy, we study steering beyond the initial effective support, where desired behaviors are rarely or never observed under the initial policy. Our key idea is to formulate preference learning as preference-conditioned generative modeling: preferred trajectories define a conditional distribution, whose density ratio with the broader behavior prior provides an implicit preference signal amplified by classifier-free guidance (CFG). Repeating this preference-conditioned modeling and guidance step yields a form of preference-guided policy iteration, turning incremental improvements toward previously inaccessible behaviors. Across diffusion policies and the PI0.5 flow- matching VLA in simulation and the real world, PrefPI produces substantial behavioral shifts with limited feedback. In particular, PrefPI increases object transport height from 10.7 cm to 19.8 cm on real hardware with only 150 preference-labeled trajectories.
2609.40165.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了PrefPI（偏好引導政策迭代），這是一個迭代框架，用於僅通過對自生成軌跡的相對偏好來引導預訓練的生成機器人政策。與先前主要通過政策已表示的模式來提升的偏好學習方法不同，我們研究了超越初始有效支持的引導，在這裡所需的行為在初始政策下很少或從未觀察到。我們的關鍵思想是將偏好學習公式化為偏好條件生成建模：偏好的軌跡定義了一個條件分佈，其與更廣泛行為先驗的密度比提供了一個隱式的偏好信號，並通過無分類器引導（CFG）進行放大。重複這個偏好條件建模和引導步驟產生了一種偏好引導政策迭代，將增量改進轉向之前無法接觸的行為。在模擬和現實世界中的擴散政策以及PI0.5流匹配VLA中，PrefPI在有限的反饋下產生了顯著的行為變化。特別是，PrefPI在真實硬體上將物體運輸高度從10.7厘米提高到19.8厘米，僅使用150個標記偏好的軌跡。
